title: SkillTrace: Multi-Trace Provenance Auditing for LLM-Agent Skill Reuse
description:
arXiv:2608.05204v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: LLM-agent ecosystems are rapidly growing around reusable skills: mixed-modality packages of metadata, natural-language instructions, code, tools, references, and operational workflows. As skills become marketplace artifacts, auditing their reuse is no longer the same problem as ordinary code clone detection.
